title: The Broken Vase
scene: At 5:45 PM, the pottery studio vase was smashed. The kiln room was locked while firing from 5:30 to 6:15.

suspects.name: Selma Ash
suspects.testimony: I was at the wheel at 5:45, shaping a bowl.
suspects.alibiProof: The wheel camera shows Selma at 5:43 and 5:49.

suspects.name: Theo Pike
suspects.testimony: I was in the kiln room at 5:45, checking the firing.
suspects.contradiction: The kiln room was locked from outside, and clay dust marked Theo's shoes.

suspects.name: Uma Vale
suspects.testimony: I was grading work at the desk at 5:45.
suspects.alibiProof: The grade book shows Uma's notes at 5:44.

suspects.name: Victor Lund
suspects.testimony: I was browsing the shelf at 5:45.
suspects.alibiProof: The shelf camera shows Victor at 5:42 and 5:50.
